story.title: Death Toll from Nepal-Tibet Flash Floods Exceeds 900 as Rescue Efforts Continue
story.summary: Flash floods along the Nepal-Tibet border have resulted in at least 900 confirmed deaths, with over 4,000 individuals reported missing. The floods, triggered by a glacier collapse, have led to extensive destruction and a large-scale rescue operation. Authorities have warned of potential further flooding as water levels in the Bhotekoshi River rise. Aid is being delivered to isolated areas by helicopter as search efforts continue.

timeline_highlights.title: Flash Floods in Nepal and Tibet Leave Hundreds Dead and Thousands Missing
timeline_highlights.summary: Devastating flash floods triggered by a glacier collapse have affected the Nepal-Tibet border, resulting in nearly 600 deaths and leaving approximately 1,900 people missing. Rescue operations are ongoing, with teams facing challenges due to the risk of further flooding from a rising lake formed by the disaster. Among the missing are at least 33 British nationals and numerous tourists from over 30 countries, prompting families to rush to the region in search of their loved ones.
key_facts: Flash floods caused by glacier collapse on the Nepal-Tibet border.
Death toll estimated at nearly 600, with around 1,900 people missing.
Rescue efforts are complicated by the risk of additional flooding.
At least 33 British nationals among those missing.

timeline_highlights.title: Rescue Efforts Intensify for Hundreds Trapped in Nepal's Hydropower Tunnels After Floods
timeline_highlights.summary: Rescue teams in Nepal are working to locate over 900 hydropower workers who are missing after devastating flash floods. Many are feared trapped in tunnels and underground areas of 12 hydropower projects. The death toll from the floods has risen to 939, according to the country's disaster management authority.

timeline_highlights.summary: Rajendra Dawadi, a school principal in Nepal, successfully evacuated over 900 students in less than 15 minutes after receiving a warning about approaching floodwaters. His swift response was crucial in saving many lives as the flood ultimately washed away the school.

related_stories.title: Jury Deliberates in Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial
related_stories.summary: Jurors are currently deliberating in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is charged with the murder of her three children. They have five options to consider: guilty of murder, guilty of manslaughter, or acquittal based on a lack of control due to psychiatric issues. This marks the third day of deliberations.

related_stories.title: Algeria Considers Death Penalty for Forest Fire Arsonists Following Deadly Blazes
related_stories.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has proposed reinstating the death penalty for individuals who deliberately set forest fires. This decision follows a series of wildfires that resulted in the deaths of 12 people and left dozens injured. Currently, 46 fires are still active, with many victims hospitalized, including some in critical condition.
